Please sign in first

Vendor reports come from verified Sun City residents, so this page needs you to be signed in to the Community Guide chat on the home page — sign in there with your email code, then come back here.

Report a problem with a listed vendor

Had a bad experience with a vendor listed in the guide? Tell us. Reports go only to the guide's administrators — nothing you write here is ever published. Repeated concerns about a vendor may result in their removal from the list.
